message: You know those gloriously over-prepared people? Well, I recently found myself in that camp! After a weekend of organizing, I discovered I had enough water bottles and snacks in our go-bag to feed a small army. 😅 While it might seem excessive, it gave me peace of mind knowing we’re ready for anything, even if it’s just a spontaneous day trip! What’s your favorite preparedness tip or little stash you keep for unexpected moments?
